notes: Four supplied object its are added; only the one governed by an object morpheme (made cakes of it) is aligned, its marker taking the of by which the English verb reaches the object (rules 16, 44).
Three assimilated bracketed articles are unrepresented, the ASV writing mills, mortars and pots bare (rule 12).
In the taste of fresh oil the innermost article takes the fronted the and lešad takes of fresh, headed on the lexeme-bearing word.
